classification.difficultyReason: Connect an absolute-value graph and its branches to two intersections, then verify both solutions by substitution.

children.label: a
children.prompt: On the same set of axes, sketch $y=|x-2|$ and $y=\frac{x}{3}$.

answer.short: See the shared graph: $y=|x-2|$ has vertex $(2,0)$ and passes through $(0,2)$; $y=\frac{x}{3}$ passes through $(0,0)$ and $(3,1)$.
answer.worked: Sketch the V-shaped graph with vertex $(2,0)$, passing through $(0,2)$ and $(4,2)$. On the same axes, draw the straight line through $(0,0)$ and $(3,1)$. The shared graph also includes the branch labels requested in part b.

spec.description: Shared solution sketch with positive-direction axis arrows, source ticks, blue absolute-value graph and orange comparison line. Branch labels complete part b. No grid or origin label.
spec.mathematics: y=|x-2| has vertex (2,0); y=x/3 intersects it at (3/2,1/2) and (3,1). Left branch y=-x+2, x<=2; right branch y=x-2, x>=2.
spec.answerVisibility: Solution only; the coloured source curves are supplied answer evidence, not student givens.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the equations of each “branch” of $y=|x-2|$ and label them on your diagram.

answer.short: Left branch: $y=-x+2$ for $x\leq2$. Right branch: $y=x-2$ for $x\geq2$.
answer.worked:
For $x\leq2$:
$$\begin{align*}y&=-(x-2)\\y&=-x+2.\end{align*}$$
For $x\geq2$:
$$y=x-2.$$
Label the left branch $y=-x+2$ and the right branch $y=x-2$.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Identify how the solutions of $|x-2|=\frac{x}{3}$ are represented on your diagram.

answer.short: The solutions are the $x$ coordinates of the points of intersection.
answer.worked: At each intersection, the two graphs have the same $y$ value, so $|x-2|=\frac{x}{3}$. Read the $x$ coordinates of these intersections.

children.label: d
children.prompt: Hence, find the solutions of $|x-2|=\frac{x}{3}$ and verify they work by substituting them back into the equation.

answer.worked:
The intersections have $x$ coordinates $\frac32$ and $3$.

For $x=\frac32$:
$$\begin{align*}\mathrm{LHS}&=\left|\frac32-2\right|\\&=\left|-\frac12\right|\\&=\frac12,\\\mathrm{RHS}&=\frac{\frac32}{3}\\&=\frac12.\end{align*}$$
For $x=3$:
$$\begin{align*}\mathrm{LHS}&=|3-2|\\&=1,\\\mathrm{RHS}&=\frac33\\&=1.\end{align*}$$
Both values satisfy the equation.
